_doc: MODEL CONFIG MANIFEST — the single versioned source for every model-semantics RL_*/PAR_* variable (gate-integrity repair, 2026-07-09, the durable half of R3). config_manifest.py loads THIS file; in BAKE/GATE mode it clears the ambient model environment, rejects unknown/divergent overrides, loads these values explicitly, and stamps config_sha256 into the produced artifacts' identity records (boot identity, book meta, gate report). Consumers verify code + store + CONFIG together. Ordinary dev-shell runs (no RL_CONFIG_MODE) are UNAFFECTED. Values are the env-string form the engine reads; they equal the current code defaults (post gate-integrity fix c, PAR_RAMPS default is 22), so clearing ambient + loading this manifest reproduces the board/book/panel byte-for-byte. Change a value ONLY at a bake, in the same commit that re-stamps config_sha256 and expected_boot.json. v2.9 COMPLETION (2026-07-14): the five wired v2.9 kill-switches (RL_PVCADOPT/RL_MSD_POOL_EXCL/RL_DIAL14/RL_AGE/RL_L5_PICKLESS) plus the two availability-layer arms surfaced by a full code audit (RL_AVAIL/RL_LTI_RETURN) are now enumerated here at their default-ON canonical values, so config_sha256 finally covers the model we ship; baked_state moved v2.7->v2.9 and the hash was re-stamped. Values still == engine defaults => board/book/panel byte-identical.

var_notes.RL_ITEM_A: #334 ITEM A — the year-1+ anchor leg (A1 full carry). 1 = live; 0 = the pre-A build, byte-exact. A declared kill-switch promoted to a manifest var so gate mode can vary it for per-item attribution without an unknown-override halt.
var_notes.RL_C_H: #334 ITEM C — THE ONE NEW DIAL. The cap-release ceiling H on the taught year-1 level: anchor_leg x (1 + w x (H-1)). Sized on the ruled PLAYED-ONLY basis so the played-only year-1 landing enters [1.04,1.13]; admissible window [1.1024,1.3327] on the #336 basis. 1.0 = no release, byte-exact.
var_notes.RL_RUC_WAGE: #334 ITEM E1 — ruck wage-ramp sizing. 1.0 = the full standard age ramp (ends the wage=0 pole denial); 0.0 reproduces the old denial byte-exact. Sized so the ruck book lands inside the ruled cautious band [+2.9%, +9.0%].
var_notes.RL_ITEM_H: #334 ITEM H — the ruled cut list (union sitters x0.280 / all-pool-sitters x0.804 / mature nonRD x0.615, cell-qualified and composing). 1 = live; 0 = no cuts, byte-exact.
var_notes.RL_AGE_DISC: #334 THE AGE-DYNAMIC FUTURE DISCOUNT (owner ruling 5246868843), the ordered counterbalance to the relativity-guard breach. 0 = OFF and byte-identical to the composed board; 1 = the per-annum future discount becomes a function of the player's CURRENT age at pricing. Balanced lens only.
var_notes.RL_AGE_DISC_LO: #334 age-dynamic discount, the YOUNG end: per-annum rate for a player priced at age <= 21. Linear in CONTINUOUS age from here to RL_AGE_DISC_HI at age 26 - no integer cliffs.
var_notes.RL_AGE_DISC_HI: #334 age-dynamic discount, the MATURE end: per-annum rate for a player priced at age >= 26.
var_notes.RL_AGE_DISC_MODE: #334 age-dynamic discount MODE. All of the owner's three variants are CURRENT-AGE keyed. 1 = V1 two-point (RL_AGE_DISC_LO/HI). 2 = V2 four-band (12% <=19 / 13% 20-21 / 15% 25-27 / 16% >=28). 3 = V3 CORRECTED (10% <=20 / 11% 21-22 / 12% 23-25 / 13% 26-28 / 14% >=29) - the owner's first filing of V3 inverted these numbers and was superseded. 9 = SEAT-PROPOSED age-at-season keying, a different machine (PV is the path product prod_j (1+r(a+j)), not (1+r)**k); low priority, run last. Inert unless RL_AGE_DISC=1.
var_notes.RL_EXP_BLEND_GAMES: #334 MENU ITEM (a), the cohort-forward young anchor: career games at which a player's own form fully replaces the explicit floor in his peak projection. 45 is the SHIPPED value and the identity. Lower values (30, 20) make a young player lean on his own form sooner and on the year-4/5 cohort prior for less of his early career. A menu item for the owner's sitting, not a decision.
var_notes.RL_TAIL_TRIM: #334 MENU ITEM (b), the proven-tail trim: fades the beyond-career-year-11 carry toward the delivered share, ramped over years 11-15, and ONLY for the population the existing far-year fade already names as proven (n >= PROVEN_N). The ruler act measured 15.1% of the year-4 price carried beyond year 11 against 9.9% delivered, talls-concentrated. 0 = shipped behaviour, byte-exact. It adds no new gate and never touches a young tail - the un-faded one the ruler act flagged. A menu item for the owner's sitting, not a decision.
var_notes.RL_A_FLOOR: #334 ITEM A FLOOR BASIS — dial-gated measurement variant for the sitting. 0 = OFF and byte-exact to the composed build (the symmetric LAM_SIT-form blend that borrows both ways). 1 = the borrowing is ONE-WAY: price = max(production-led value, blended value) at the A site, so the prior supports from below and production leads from above. The directive's replacement line said 'anchor leg, FLOOR basis'; this measures that reading. Inert whenever anch < e_full, so it cannot undo the surprise law on a hot thin record.
var_notes.RL_A_DRAGFADE: #334 ITEM A EVIDENCE-FADED DRAG — dial-gated measurement variant for the sitting, the middle design between the symmetric blend and the hard floor. 0 = OFF and byte-exact to the composed build. 1 = in the DRAG case only (anchor below the production-led value), the anchor's weight is scaled by (1-w) with w the ITEM C evidence weight G*Q*gate, clipped to [0,1] because Q is capped at 2 and an unclamped (1-w) would invert the leg. The SUPPORT case keeps the existing games-fade untouched. w is computed once per call and serves both the C ceiling release and this drag fade, so sa is read once per row.
var_notes.RL_A_GSAT: #334 ITEM A RAMP DE-COUPLE — dial-gated measurement variant for the sitting (RAMP_DECOUPLE_SPEC.md). 0 = OFF and byte-exact to the composed build: ITEM A's anchor share saturates on WITHIN-SEASON games at pace against the six-game bar, so at cohort year 1 the admission gate (ns>=1 needs gy/fE>=6) and the saturation (LAM_SIT[6]=1.0) are mutually exclusive and A's share is exactly 0. A positive value G is the career-games saturation scale: lam = interp(min(career_games/G,1)*6, [0..6], LAM_SIT), so a qualified year-1 row carries real anchor weight. THE ADMISSION BAR IS NOT TOUCHED (still 6*fE prorated) and sitout_ev's own LAM_SIT read is NOT touched — this dial is read at exactly one site, _a_share. 18 is the seat's choice inside the spec's open ~15-20 range; it is not an owner number.
var_notes.RL_336_NOP: #336 CHANNEL ABLATION LEVER (a) — THE P-LEG. DECLARED MEASUREMENT DIAL, not a design dial; no owner has ruled it on and nothing ships from it. 0 = OFF and byte-exact. 1 = the unconditional probability factor P(ever establishes) comes off the pick reference tables (BPK = E[level|est] rather than P x E[level|est]; POOL becomes the establisher-only band marginal rather than the bust-inclusive one) and the residual anchor-side discount D goes to 1.0. The de-survivored conditional LEVELS are untouched. Exists because the #336 layer owns 80.5% of the main->FULL year-1 drop and was the one item in the act with no declared kill-switch — its only ablation was a whole-commit revert in a throwaway worktree.
var_notes.RL_336_SURVLVL: #336 CHANNEL ABLATION LEVER (b) — THE DE-SURVIVORED E-LEVELS. DECLARED MEASUREMENT DIAL, not a design dial. 0 = OFF and byte-exact. 1 = the conditional mean's sample reverts to the pre-#336 survivor definition (membership `pkbest(p) is not None`, i.e. a >=10-game season, at the level pkbest itself), so the 148 established-but-never-10-game players stop teaching; and the v3.4 late-pick clamp is RESTORED on both BASEPK_REG and BASEPK_EST, because the clamp exists only to patch the spike the survivor sample produces. P's own numerator is NOT touched and stays on the ruled >=6-game bar, so this channel and (a) stay orthogonal in code. THIS ARM IS A COUNTERFACTUAL FOR MEASUREMENT ONLY: softening the de-survivored levels re-admits survivor bias, which the owner's standing ruling bars.
var_notes.RL_336_PARSURV: #336 CHANNEL ABLATION LEVER (c) — THE PAR_BUILD LEG. DECLARED MEASUREMENT DIAL, not a design dial. 0 = OFF and byte-exact. 1 = par_build.gather()'s observation gate reverts to the shipped pre-#336 `g >= MIN_GAMES` (survivors-at-that-tenure) from `g >= 1 and ever-established`. That one gate is the WHOLE par-side channel: amendment 2/3's par-side machinery (build_pest / pest_of / resolved_336 / resolve_w / dpar_of and the A3 constants) has NO consumer outside par_build.py — par_redesign.py carries its own par_at and never calls them — so the only way #336 reaches the engine through forward_valuation is by changing which observations the par surface is fitted to.
var_notes.RL_336_CLAMP: #336 CHANNEL (b) PARTNER LEVER — the v3.4 late-pick basepk clamp. DECLARED MEASUREMENT DIAL, not a design dial. 0 = OFF and byte-exact (the clamp is removed, as #336 landed it). 1 = `row[b]=min(row[b],row[b-1])` is restored on BOTH BASEPK_REG and BASEPK_EST. Held on its own lever rather than folded into RL_336_SURVLVL because the clamp and the survivor sample are separable in code and the measurement needs to say which of the two moves the amendment-2 monotonicity guard (basepk_est >= basepk). Channel (b) is emitted as RL_336_SURVLVL=1 RL_336_CLAMP=1: the clamp exists only to patch the late-pick spike the survivor sample produces, so reverting the sample without it would measure a configuration the engine never had.
var_notes.RL_336_XW: #336 ORDER 4 — EXPOSURE WEIGHTING OF THE PAR SAMPLE. ADOPTED AND SHIPPED BY OWNER WORD (filed 5249802288) - DEFAULT IS NOW ON. RL_336_XW=0 is the ablation. Originally wired as a dial-gated measurement variant, default off and byte-exact when off (ws=None is passed through the fit, so the off path never multiplies at all). 1 = every par observation enters the local-linear level fit, the per-tenure ramp median and the ramp isotonic weights at min(games, RL_336_XW_CAP) instead of at 1.0. NOTHING IS DROPPED: every row of the #336 bust-inclusive sample stays in the sample; only the weights change. Rationale independent of #336: par is a PER-GAME benchmark consumed as the denominator of Q = sa/par where sa is the career GAMES-WEIGHTED average, so an equal-weight par divides a games-weighted numerator by a season-weighted denominator. Cleared the ORDER 4 honesty test before wiring (XW_HONESTY.txt): sub-6-game rows keep 4.8% of pooled fit weight against 19.7% of the row count, the estimator diverges from the survivors-only one in 37 of 44 informative cells, and at tenure 1 in the late pick bands it lands BELOW survivors-only. NO OWNER RULING HAS BEEN MADE ON IT AND NOTHING SHIPS FROM IT.
var_notes.RL_336_XW_CAP: #336 ORDER 4 — the exposure cap for RL_336_XW, in games. 18 = a full season's exposure. Inert when RL_336_XW=0. It is the CONSERVATIVE choice of the three weights measured: uncapped games and the target's own recency-weighted exposure both move the par level FURTHER from the as-built value, so the cap works against the design rather than for it. Disclosed here rather than left to be discovered.

var_notes.RL_B_SHAPE: #334 ITEM B, the pool year-0 draft-age shape. RETIRED TO FLAT BY OWNER RULING (5249802288: "B to flat"). 0 = DEFAULT and SHIPPED: _b_shape == 1.0 at every age, so _b_renorm() == 1.0 and _b_factor == 1.0 exactly; entry_anchor collapses to pool_level x _PL_F and the C5 level-preserving law holds TRIVIALLY (no value moves between ages). 1 = the taught knots (0.6859 / 1.4112 / 2.8173), kept in code for the re-derivation. Grounds filed at B_PROVENANCE_AND_SPLITS.md: the shipped 21+ factor was k x 2.8173 = 2.0478 (+104.8% on the entry anchor) and it was NOT fitted to play quality - the outcome measure D_rt_win is realized DELIVERY off the seasons and bars, a composite raised by playing more as well as better. On the non-rookie arm quality is flat across draft age (51.47/52.98/53.33) while the 21+ slice plays the LEAST (21.6 career games). RECORDED INVESTIGATION ITEM for the pool repricing act.
